reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, dayFromDate and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but writes its own daily-skip-vs-move weekend decision instead of extracting one shared occurrence-adjustment helper from getUpcomingDates/getNextDate.

duplication.why: The 'skipWeekend && daily ? drop weekend : move with solve mode' rule is now spelled out a fourth time (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template, new handler), plus the same try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper as getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: Handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered in the handler map, matching where the tree puts sibling handlers; the weekend rule itself would better live in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its type registration, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and readable, but a future change to weekend handling must be repeated here as well as in the other copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend and RSchedule rather than going around them; the daily rule has no shared abstraction to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange: the daily-skip/move branching of getUpcomingDates is reshaped from two separate code paths into a per-occurrence if/else inside the loop rather than shared.
